source_terms: Research purposes only; not for commercial use. Do not redistribute source images in runner releases.
selection: The English pages of the router development set (reference/router-dev-v1-manifest.json: every English OmniDocBench page outside corpus v1/v2/v3 and the English gate v1 with text ground truth), minus every page whose document family holds a corpus v1/v2/v3 or English gate v1 page; categories by priority ['tiny_text', 'formulas', 'tables', 'multi_column', 'ordinary', 'slides', 'exam', 'other'] (select_english_gate.category, then other with >= 100 characters; pages with neither dropped); one page per family, no quotas, chosen by category priority then SHA-256 rank with seed falcon-cpu-fast-defaults-gate-v1.
family_rule: connected components over every annotated page of shared keys: gate_family, select_corpus_v3.source_family with the corpus v3 review's assignments, the title of book_en_<title>_N pages, and the source_family recorded by corpus v1/v2/v3 and English gate v1; source_family below is the component's smallest key
image_hashes: LFS SHA-256 from the Hub tree listing of aa1ee96d106dbe53d0ae59474d75c6e6d9b53fec (equal to router-dev-v1's)
